given: a first launch in airplane mode
then: L01–L05 are enabled and selecting any level loads its initial board without authentication.
the player moves one cell if traversable; a wall or out-of-board input preserves board, history, and steps and shows blocked feedback.

given: a crate adjacent to the player
then: both move one cell only if the cell beyond is traversable and crate-free; two adjacent crates and wall-backed crates remain unchanged.
the preceding player/crate state is restored, history loses one entry, steps increase by one, and time is not reduced; Undo is disabled when history is empty.
play pauses for confirmation; Cancel retains its state and Confirm resets board, history, steps, and elapsed time using a new attempt ID.
inputs and active timer stop; Resume continues the same board and counter without counting the paused interval.

when: a valid move, blocked move, then valid undo occur
then: displayed steps are 1, 1, and 2 respectively; elapsed time advances only while active.

when: the app is reopened and Continue is chosen
then: level/version, positions, history, steps, and elapsed time are restored and play resumes from pause; no save disables Continue.

when: any level is played, paused, restarted, completed, or resumed
then: those operations remain available and completion results are stored locally.

given: one or more crates not on goals
when: the last crate reaches its goal
then: one completion is recorded, time/inputs freeze, the unfinished save is cleared, and best steps/time update only if improved.

when: a pending result is ready and network is available
then: anonymous authentication creates a guest profile automatically; failure preserves the result and does not block gameplay.

when: sending fails and the same result is retried
then: it retains that UUID; a duplicate successful server receipt creates no second record, and the local item becomes synced only after acknowledgement.
at most 20 best-per-guest entries appear in the specified deterministic order; changing level never shows another level's entries as current.

given: loading, zero results, a request failure, or no network
then: it presents an explicit state with retry/navigation; cached data is labeled with level and last-updated time.
it explains four directions, pushing versus pulling, goal symbols, completion, undo, and restart; closing returns to Home.
a short effect plays; disabling sound persists across restart and suppresses effects; background and pause stop playback.
one short haptic pulse occurs; blocked moves and background produce none.
